executive_summary.headline: World supply-route stress and energy costs are driving AMBER status after a week of geopolitical de-escalation in China supplier risk.
executive_summary.next_step: Monitor Strait of Hormuz transit volumes daily and check whether Rhine water levels stabilize above 40 cm at Kaub within 48 hours; if both persist, model input-cost pass-through and flag procurement timelines for energy-intensive suppliers.
executive_summary.context: Five China-based electronics suppliers (IP Sun, Porton, Huizhou BYD Electronic, Smoore, EVE Energy) moved from HIGH to MEDIUM risk 90.5 hours ago following geopolitical signal updates, but that relief is now offset by acute physical chokepoints: Hormuz transits collapsed 97% year-on-year, Rhine navigation is impaired, and Brent crude and aluminium have spiked well above seasonal norms. Two unexplained stock price moves (Infineon −5.5%, ITC −4.0%) carry high exposure and remain unconfirmed.
